Source-to-sink: UploadSet.save() splits a slash-containing caller name into folder+basename (os.path.split), runs file_allowed() only on get_basename(storage.filename), then replaces basename with the unsanitized name and os.path.join(destination, folder, basename) with no containment check. An allowed upload (e.g. JPEG in IMAGES) can therefore be stored as ../templates/rce.html; rendering that file is SSTI/RCE. Pre-fix code at 9e813e919c4f8d9ef17c7fe8ecc0c2efa8fee118:src/flask_uploads/flask_uploads.py lines 312-337 still has that order; parent of the BIC at bb79c1def3a0940f929bc2cc0038047b36b9b2d8:flask_uploads.py lines 405-428 validated the post-override basename and would reject a disallowed .html extension.
